en: The image depicts an old, grand stone gate with two large wooden doors set into an arched entrance, partially overgrown with foliage. There is a person standing at one of the doors, which are weathered and marked by diagonal planks. The structure appears to be part of a historical ruin or castle, with visible stonework and remnants of upper floors or walls. The overall tone is sepia, suggesting an early 20th-century or late 19th-century photograph. At the bottom of the postcard, there is printed German text.
